wire.t: Washington beat the Giants 24-21 Thursday night, and Stefon Diggs caught the winning 32-yard touchdown from Jayden Daniels with 57 seconds left. Diggs scored 17.8 for Dude, Your Getting a Dell, which is already 22% of Br0phy's season average.

Cam Skattebo ran for two touchdowns (18 carries, 78 yards, plus 44 receiving) and scored 28.7 for OBJAY. Washington's Antonio Williams caught a 31-yard touchdown and scored 11.7 on OBJAY's taxi squad.

Isaiah Likely had 9 catches for 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown, 29.7 points for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. J.J. McCarthy threw for 293 yards and scored 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench. jmello16 starts C.J. Stroud on Sunday.

Jayden Daniels threw three touchdowns and two interceptions for 27.76, and Malik Nabers had 5 catches for 44 yards and a lost fumble (5.4). I Chase Brown Kids leads Bourbon Lover 33.16 to 0.30, because Devin Singletary got one carry.

Bill_Buttlicker took Makai Lemon out of the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte lineup. Chris Rodriguez Jr. and AJ Barner are in. Kaleb Johnson and Ashton Dulin are still on the bench, and there are no bye-week starters left anywhere in the league.

Thursday practice: Mike Evans and Bhayshul Tuten (Jefferson’s Reserve) did not practice again. Denzel Boston (StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte), T.J. Hockenson (Catfan94’s Farm Team) and Tony Pollard (Bourbon Lover) also sat. All five are in Week 10 lineups.
Jonathan Taylor (Kraft for Cash) was a full participant Thursday after being limited Wednesday. Alvin Kamara and Jared Goff were full too. Kyler Murray (Asian Jim) did not practice.

stories.title: J.J. McCarthy drops 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench, and Bill_Buttlicker finally benches Makai Lemon
stories.dek: Washington wins 24-21 on a Stefon Diggs touchdown with 57 seconds left. OBJAY, I Chase Brown Kids and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bank the points.
body: Washington beat the Giants 24-21, and the best fantasy performance wasn't in anybody's lineup on the team that needed it. J.J. McCarthy threw for 293 yards and scored 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench. That's two weeks in a row: C.J. Stroud had 50.36 on the bench in Week 9, so jmello16 started Stroud this week, and now the other one went off. Stroud plays Sunday, so this one isn't over, but Jefferson’s Reserve is down 29.7 to 0.00 to LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix before kickoff.
That 29.7 is Isaiah Likely, who had 9 catches, 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown. Catfan94 is 8‑1, a 43.4-point favorite, and got a head start from his tight end. Must be nice.

OBJAY got 28.7 from Cam Skattebo and his two touchdowns, so JAY2913 leads Catfan94’s Farm Team 28.70 to 0.00. Antonio Williams also caught a 31-yard touchdown for Washington and scored 11.7 on OBJAY's taxi squad. I Chase Brown Kids leads Bourbon Lover 33.16 to 0.30 behind Jayden Daniels (27.76, three touchdowns, two picks). Devin Singletary got one carry. Dude, Your Getting a Dell got 17.8 from Stefon Diggs, including the winning touchdown, and leads The Champ 17.80 to 0.00. Br0phy is 0‑9 and has a lead. Screenshot it.

And yes, I fixed it. Makai Lemon is out of the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte lineup, Chris Rodriguez Jr. and AJ Barner are in, and the league has zero bye-week starters. I'm still a 41.2-point underdog to Hold My DK, Denzel Boston didn't practice Thursday, and Kaleb Johnson and Ashton Dulin are still on my bench. Baby steps.

stories.dek: Mike Evans, Bhayshul Tuten, Denzel Boston, T.J. Hockenson and Tony Pollard. Friday's report decides a lot of lineups.
body: Thursday's practice report has five players who did not practice and are still in Week 10 lineups. Two are on Jefferson’s Reserve: Mike Evans, who hasn't played since Oct. 19, and Bhayshul Tuten. jmello16 has Chris Godwin Jr. on bye, Jaylen Waddle out and Braelon Allen in the lineup, so the options are thin. stories.title: Week 9 recap: Catfan94’s Farm Team drops 180.30, The Champ loses with the highest losing score, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑9
stories.dek: A 97.38-point blowout, a 6.28-point nail-biter and three starters below zero.
body: Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Jefferson’s Reserve 180.30 to 82.92, a 97.38-point margin and the biggest of the week. Kenneth Walker III had 36.8, Brock Purdy 31.28, Christian Watson 28.6 and Bucky Irving 27.5. jrsmith1391 is 6‑3 and has won two straight.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat The Champ 164.84 to 127.74. Jordan Love scored 42.18, Ja'Marr Chase 30.0 and Brock Bowers 24.3, and Catfan94 is 8‑1 with five wins in a row. TJohn91 had the highest losing score of the week and still lost by 37.10. Josh Jacobs scored -0.5 in the lineup, and Boutte (29.5) and Matthew Stafford (13.22) sat on the bench.

Hold My DK beat Bourbon Lover 147.12 to 86.20 behind Puka Nacua at 32.5 and Christian McCaffrey at 23.7. Kraft for Cash beat I Chase Brown Kids 121.74 to 99.86, and Asian Jim beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 86.00 to 68.34, which is the lowest score of the week. Br0phy is 0‑9.

StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte beat OBJAY 115.16 to 108.88 by 6.28, the closest game of the week. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑6 with Drake Maye at 24.76. JAY2913 had Efton Chism III on the bench with 14.4, and swapping him in for Emeka Egbuka (6.4) would have won it 116.88 to 115.16.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks, and four contenders own none
stories.dek: The picks through 2029 are lopsided, and the standings are too.
body: Counting 2027 through 2029, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte owns 12 first-round picks, which is a full first round's worth of picks. JAY2913 is next with six on OBJAY, then ZachCarroll09 with five on I Chase Brown Kids and Br0phy with four on Dude, Your Getting a Dell.

Kraft for Cash, Catfan94’s Farm Team, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK own zero first-round picks over that stretch, and they are the top four teams in the standings. That's a bet on now, and it's working while the whole group is 6‑3 or better.
The risk is that all four teams are on the wrong side of a rebuild in three years, and the one with 12 first-round picks is 3‑6 with 27-72 all-play. Tyler's plan is a long one.

columns.title: Five quarterbacks is not a strategy, jmello16
columns.dek: Jefferson’s Reserve has left 72.48 points on the bench at quarterback in two weeks.
body: I'll be fair to jmello16 first. Starting C.J. Stroud this week after he put up 50.36 is a defensible call. Stroud plays Sunday and could still outscore J.J. McCarthy's 22.12. Nobody gets fired over a Thursday.

But here's the number: 50.36 in Week 9 and 22.12 in Week 10. That's 72.48 points at quarterback on the bench over two weeks. In superflex you're supposed to start two of these guys, and Jefferson’s Reserve keeps guessing on which two.

Five quarterbacks on one roster is a hoarding problem, not depth. Trade one. Asian Jim has Kyler Murray missing practice. Somebody in this league will pay for a 23-year-old who just threw for 293 yards.
Mike Evans and Bhayshul Tuten didn't practice Thursday either. Read the Friday report, set the lineup, and quit leaving points in the parking lot.

columns.title: 4 lineup tips from Holden McGroin, who once started a punter at flex
columns.dek: Thursday taught us a lot. Holden learned none of it.
body: 1. Always start the quarterback who scored the most on your bench last week. jmello16 did this and got 0.00 Thursday while the other guy scored 22.12. The system works, just one week late. Every week.
2. Put your touchdown scorers on the taxi squad. Antonio Williams caught a 31-yard touchdown for JAY2913 and scored 11.7 where it doesn't count. That's what I call saving points for later.
3. Fix bye weeks last, like Bill_Buttlicker. Waiting until you're the only team left with a bye-week starter shows confidence. It also makes you the lead story on your own website.

4. Start running backs who get one carry. Devin Singletary had one carry for 0.3. That's 0.3 points per carry, and if you give him 400 carries he gets 120 points. paknight12 just needs the Giants to do the math.

columns.title: Bourbon Lover is losing by 110.5 times
columns.dek: Thursday's scores, measured the only way that matters: by me.
body: I Chase Brown Kids leads Bourbon Lover 33.16 to 0.30. Divide those and ZachCarroll09 is ahead by a factor of 110.5. In my model that's the biggest lead in league history, because nobody else divides.

Stefon Diggs scored 17.8, which is 22.4% of Dude, Your Getting a Dell's season average of 79.64. If Br0phy keeps that pace for the other three days, the projection is 71.2 points of Diggs and a perfect season from here.
J.J. McCarthy's 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench is 17.8% of jmello16's average week. Stefon Diggs scored 17.8 points. I'm calling it the McCarthy-Diggs Constant and I'll be publishing a paper.
Cam Skattebo's 28.7 is 23.5% of OBJAY's average, done in one night. OBJAY is a 24.6-point underdog and already leads by 28.7, so by my math JAY2913 has won by 4.1 points and should stop watching now.

exits.t: Threw for 293 yards and scored 22.12 on the bench Thursday, a week after the other bench quarterback scored 50.36. Jefferson’s Reserve has five quarterbacks and keeps starting the wrong one.
Caught a 31-yard touchdown Thursday and scored 11.7 on OBJAY's taxi squad, where points don't count. Wants a roster spot that counts.
Scored 14.3 on the bench in Week 9 and is still on the bench in Week 10, even after Bill_Buttlicker finally fixed the bye-week spot. Wants a manager who checks the depth chart.
Scored 14.4 on the bench in a 6.28-point loss in Week 9, and he's on the bench again with Emeka Egbuka and Luther Burden III on bye.
Scored 29.5 on the bench in Week 9 and still isn't starting for The Champ. Wants a team that reads its own box scores.
Scored 16.48 on the bench in Week 9 behind Josh Allen and Jordan Love. Wants a starting job somewhere, preferably on a team without two better quarterbacks.
